lines.text: Press is froze solid. Forty years and never in September.
You've got a way with cold, don't you? Coax it out of there.
Running sweet as June. Don't tell Ada I said thank you.
Saw the frost come down off the hill this morning. Followed the old wall, near as I could tell.
First pressing since you got her running. Mulled it myself. Don't go thinking it means anything.
Rime right through the screw. That's no ordinary frost.
Easy now. Let go of it, there's a good press.

found.note: Silas presses one into your hand
